grain_rationale: One source row is one invoice line event: the profile shows row_count 44721 with duplicate_row_rate 0.0, so no exact duplicates exist and no roll-up is needed. No single column is unique on its own (invoice_id has 2330 distinct values across 44721 rows, stock_code 3141), so a derived identity over the tuple (invoice_id, stock_code, invoiced_at, quantity, unit_price) identifies a line; with a zero duplicate_row_rate this tuple absorbs nothing and declares the natural line grain.

fields.name: invoice_id
fields.description: Invoice document identifier grouping lines into an order, shown as numeric-looking strings such as 489434 with null_rate 0.0 and 2330 distinct invoices across 44721 lines.

fields.name: is_cancellation
fields.description: Flag marking a line as part of a cancellation, with exactly two distinct values (true, false) and null_rate 0.0; consistent with the negative quantities seen in the profile.

fields.name: stock_code
fields.description: Product stock code labeling the item sold, with 3141 distinct alphanumeric codes such as 10002R and 10123C and null_rate 0.0.

fields.name: product_description
fields.description: Human-readable product description such as '12 PENCILS SMALL TUBE POSY'; nullable with null_rate 0.005098 (228 nulls), likely missing where the catalog carried no description for a code.

fields.name: quantity
fields.description: Units sold on the line, an additive quantity ranging from -1395 to 5184 where negative values in the samples indicate cancellations or returns; null_rate 0.0.

fields.name: invoiced_at
fields.description: Timestamp the invoice line was recorded, resolving to the minute in samples such as 2009-12-01T07:45:00, spanning 2009-12-01 to 2009-12-23 with null_rate 0.0.

fields.name: unit_price
fields.description: Price per unit for the line, a numeric amount ranging from 0.0 to 1998.49 that is compared and combined with quantity across rows; null_rate 0.0, with 0.0 prices present in the samples.

fields.name: customer_id
fields.description: Customer identifier stored as an integer (12346 to 18287) that labels rather than measures; nullable with null_rate 0.300664 (13446 nulls), consistent with anonymous or guest purchases carrying no customer.

fields.name: country
fields.description: Customer or shipping country for the invoice, with 24 distinct values such as Australia, EIRE, and Germany and null_rate 0.0.

category_description: One row is one invoice line: a single product (stock_code) sold or cancelled in a given quantity at a unit price on a specific invoice at a specific minute, attributed to a country and, when known, a customer.
purpose: Declares how silver.silver_invoice_lines enters the gold unified event star as the invoice_lines fact category, naming the time column, the transaction grain with its derived line identity, and the role of every mapped column for the deterministic modeling engine that emits the gold models.
usage: This mapping is rendered into an ODCS mapping contract draft, validated against the frozen mapping-contract schema, gated by the validator and datacontract lint, and human-reviewed before approval; the modeling engine consumes the approved contract to generate the gold fact and dimension models, and no physical object is created by the mapping itself.
limitations: The mapping does not filter or transform rows: cancellation lines (is_cancellation true, with negative quantities down to -1395) and zero-priced lines (unit_price min 0.0) are mapped as-is, leaving their exclusion or handling to consumers; the 30.07% null customer_id rows remain in the fact without customer attribution, and product_description nulls (228 rows) are passed through unresolved.
